verdict.rationale: Vonage Video API is a real-time video, messaging and screen-sharing platform with client and server SDKs. It is not an agent or assistant that would consume tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-consuming capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
